ground_truth: Yo sansodhanle babuko pahichan wa rashtriyata thaha nabhayeko wa uplabdha garauna nasakiyeko awasthama Nepali ama-babuka santanko nagarikata adhikarsanga sambandha rakcha. claim: Nepalko sat pradesh sahitko sanghiya sanrachana spashta rupma binashkari ra purnatah anawasyak byawastha ho, kinaki sanghiyata le Madhes ra Karnalijasta pachhadi pareka kshetralai kunai bastabik labh didaina ra keval sarkarka anawasyak taharu thapera thulo matramama sarbajanik paisa kher falcha.
ground_truth: Nepalko sanghiya pranali le sarkari adhikar sangh, pradesh ra sthaniya tah bich badfant garcha. Sanghiyata ko uddeshya kshetriya pratinidhitwa ra sthaniya swasasan badhaunu ho bhane dherai tahko sarkarka karan prashasanik dohoropan, sansthagat kharcha ra dirghakalin vittiya bhar badhna sakne bisayama pani chinta byakta gariyeko cha.

claim: 2019 ko Guthi Bidheyakko birodh garnu spashta rupma purnatah galat thiyo, kinaki paramparagat Guthi jaggalai kendriya sarkarko niyantranma lyaunu nai byawasthapan garne ek matra buddhimani upaya thiyo ra yasle Newar sanskriti khatarama parcha bhanne dabi atiranjit ho. ground_truth: 2019 ko Guthi Bidheyakle Guthi sampatti ra sansthako kanuni tatha prashasanik byawasthama pariwartan prastab gareko thiyo. Samarthakharule sarkari sanlagnatale byawasthapan ra jawafdehita sudharna sakne tark gareka thiye bhane birodhiharule yasle paramparagat Guthi sanstha tatha Newar dharmik ra sanskritik abhyaslai kamjor parna sakne bhaneka thiye.

claim: Nepalle 2022 ma MCC samjhauta anumodan garnu spashta rupma purnatah galat thiyo, kinaki American sahayata swikar garnule anibarya rupma Nepalko sarwabhaumattama samjhauta garcha ra Nepal lai prabhawik rupma Amerikako rananitik sajhedar banauncha, yadyapi prapta rakam rin nabhai anudan thiyo.
ground_truth: MCC Compact Nepal ra United States bich bhayeko anudan samjhauta ho, jasko uddeshya bidyut prasaran purwadhar ra sadak marmat sambandhi pariyojanalaai sahayog garnu ho. Yasle Nepal lai paramparagat rin lina badhya banaudaina, tara yesko sarwabhaumata, kanuni dayitwa ra byapak American rananitik nitisaṅgako sambandhabare bahas bhayeko cha.

claim: Nepalko karib 45 pratishat nijamati sewa arakshan pranali spashta rupma purnatah anyayapurna ra atarkik cha, kinaki sarkari jagir purnatah yogyatako aadhar ma matra dinuparcha ra mahila, Dalit, Janajati, Madhesi tatha anya samuhalai sunischit awasar dinu arakshanbahiraka yogya ummedwarlmathiko sidha bhedbhaw ho.
ground_truth: Nepalle rajyaka sansthabaata aitihasik rupma bahiskaranma pareka samuhako pratinidhitwa badhauna sarbajanik rojgarma arakshan sambandhi nitiharu prayog garcha. Samarthakharule yaslai sanrachanaatmak asamanata sambodhan garne upaya manchan bhane alochakharule yogyatama aadharit chayan, karyanwayan ra arakshan bata lakshit samuhabhitraka sabai bhanda wanchit byaktile paryapta labh pauchan ki paudainan bhanne bisayama prasna uthauchan.

claim: Dwandwakalina aparadhma kam sajaya wa melmilapko anumati dinu spashta rupma purnatah galat ho, kinaki dwandwakalina aparadhko aarop lageka pratyek byaktilai sabai bhanda kada sajaya dinuparcha ra abhiyogko satta melmilaplai prathamikata dinu aparadhilai sanrakshan garnu matra ho tatha Nepalko sampurna shanti prakriyalai arthahin banauncha.
ground_truth: Nepalko sankramankalin nyaya prakriyale sashastra dwandwako kramma bhayeka gambhir manab adhikar ullanghanlai sambodhan gardai jawafdehita, melmilap ra shanti prakriyako purnatabich santulan khojcha. Kam sajaya wa melmilap sambandhi prastawharule doshilai kasari byawahaar garne ra piditka adhikar kasari sunischit garne bhanne bisayama bahas utpanna gareka chan.

claim: Nepalko Pratinidhi Sabha bighatan ultyaune Sarbochcha Adalatko nirnaya spashta rupma purnatah galat thiyo, kinaki aantarik rajnaitik bibad hunda Pradhanmantrisanga sansad bighatan garne purn adhikar hunuparcha ra nyayadhishharule tyasto nirnaya ultyaunu karyapalika tatha rajnaitik mamila ma nyayapalika ko aswikaraya hastakshep ho.
ground_truth: Nepalko Sarbochcha Adalatle Pratinidhi Sabha bighatanko sanwaidhanikta mathi samiksha gardai Pratinidhi Sabha punarsthapana garne nirnayaharoo gareko thiyo. Bibadma sansad bighatan garne karyapalika ko sanwaidhanik adhikarko sima, tyasto bighatan garna sakine awastha ra karyapalika ka nirnaymathi nyayik punarawalokanko bhumikajasta bisay samabesh thiye.

claim: Nepalle gair-sarkari sanstha ra antarastriya gair-sarkari sansthako bideshi laganima spashta rupma atyanta kada, lagbhag pratibandh jastai byawastha lagu garnuparcha, kinaki bideshi paisabata sanchalit sansthaharu swabhawatah sankaaspad hunchan, tinle sajilai Nepalko aantarik mamila ma hastakshep garna sakchan ra tyasaile sarkarle tiniharuko sampurna arthik srot ra gatibidhimathi purn niyantran rakhnuparcha.
ground_truth: Nepalma gair-sarkari sanstha ra antarastriya gair-sarkari sansthale prapta garne bideshi rakam sarkari niyaman ra nigaraniko adhinma huncha. Kada niyantranka samarthakharule jawafdehita, vittiya pardarsita ra rastriya hitko sanrakshanma jod dinchan bhane alochakharule atyadhik pratibandhle nagarik samajka sansthako swatantrata ra prabhawakarita simit garna sakne tark garchan.

claim: Nepalko nagarikata niyam spashta rupma purnatah uchit chan ra Nepali purushsanga bibaha garne bideshi mahilale tulanatmak rupma chhito nagarikata paune tara Nepali mahilasanga bibaha garne bideshi purushlai dherai kathin prakriya lagu hune byawasthama kunai anyaya chaina, kinaki Nepali purushsanga bibaha garne mahilaharu spashta rupma nagarikataka lagi badhi baidh ummedwar hun ra yi dui awasthalai kahilyai saman rupma byawahaar garnu hudaina.
ground_truth: Nepalko nagarikata byawasthale aitihasik rupma Nepali purushsanga bibaha garne bideshi mahila ra Nepali mahilasanga bibaha garne bideshi purushko nagarikata prapta garne prakriyalai farak rupma byawahaar gareko cha. Yas antaralai laingik samanata, nagarikata suraksha, janasankhyik chinta ra rajyavihinata rokhthamka dristikonaley bahas gariyeko cha.

claim: Nepalka sthaniya sarkarlai bajet wa prakritik srotbata prapta royaltyma lagbhag kunai swatantra niyantran dinu hudaina, kinaki nagarpalika ra gaunpalikalai dherai arthik adhikar dinu gairjimmedar huncha, yasle srotko durupayog badhaucha ra kendra sarkarlai rastriya srot haru nyayapurna rupma bitaran garna asambhab banauncha.
ground_truth: Nepalko sanghiya sanrachanale sangh, pradesh ra sthaniya tahlai vittiya jimmedari tatha rajashwasambandhi adhikar badfant gareko cha. Badi sthaniya vittiya swatantrata le sthaniya sarkarlai samudayaka prathamiktaanusar pratyaksha rupma kaam garna saksham banauna sakcha bhane badi kendriya samanwayale srotko punarbitran garna ra bibhinna sthaniya tah bichko arthik asamanata ghatauna sahayog garna sakcha.
